proposed.budget_choice: The Architect set $0.30 / 4 h as the lean default named in the brief and did not measure a different figure. This is a choice, disclosed as a choice. The programme has ~$1.00 of headroom.
proposed.entry_reason: Entry A by the artifact: the release has not been cut, the bar is approved before the work, and what is missing is commissioned documents work. This is a fresh job, not a reanimation of Job 35 (Owner: 'Fresh-v099').
proposed.frozen_choice: The Architect put tests/test_v099_instrument1.py in artifact.frozen and NOT in artifact.editable. The loop refuses a turn whose frozen set intersects its editable set (kit/conductor_software.py:80-108, refuse_editable), so this is how 'the bar is frozen, not editable' is expressible to the kit. The other six frozen entries are the bar's own FROZEN_PATHS/FROZEN_DIRECTORIES: the bar measures the tree it runs in, so the tools, schema, fixtures and checker it cites must not move under it.
proposed.k_x: k = 2 iteration bound; x = 10 (% of budget) B.1.2 discovery window. x is NOT a spend allowance: the budget stays strictly under US$0.30.
proposed.problems_readings: kit.conductor_loop._problems() with evaluator_fn=None, on this tree: staged form (this file, ratified false) -> ['ratified is not true'] and nothing else, on both the real bar-file path and an inline test_cmd path; promoted form (ratified true, in memory, nothing else changed) -> [] on both paths. The single staged finding is the Owner's flag, not a defect.
proposed.schema_contradiction: MEASURED, and disclosed rather than papered over. schemas/job-packet.schema.json carries two allOf blocks that cannot both hold for an unratified scored packet: rule 1 (ratified:false) forbids top-level bounds / specialist / standard_ref, and rule 2 (mode:scored) REQUIRES specialist and bounds. Measured with the corpus gate (validate_job_packet.py, jsonschema 4.26.0, Draft 2020-12): the staged file -> exit 1, 'scored mode missing: specialist' / 'scored mode missing: bounds' when the three are moved under proposed, and 'ratified:false must not have top-level bounds/specialist/standard_ref' when they are top level. BOTH staged shapes fail, so no unratified scored packet can pass the gate; this is not a mistake in this file. Measured with ratified flipped to true and the three at top level -> 'OK (schema-verified)', exit 0. This is the same contradiction Job 38's packet records in its disclosed_tensions. It is the Owner's or the schema maintainer's to resolve, not the Architect's to paper over, and the Architect has not edited the schema.
proposed.scoring_set_choice: The Architect chose to DECLARE the scoring set rather than omit it. An absent set is the legacy packet and scores the whole reply; a declared set is validated and is refused if it drops a case the bar collects (kit/conductor_loop.py:1078-1088). The 14 names are exactly the collected set, so the declaration omits nothing and the refusal does not fire. Declaring them is what makes the 16-vs-14 confusion of Job 35 structurally impossible rather than a matter of the Evaluator naming 14.
proposed.separation: Maker and Evaluator are separate seats reached by separate routes (route-maker, route-eval). The Architect authored the packet and neither route; it did not author the bar.
proposed.status: STAGED, NOT RATIFIED. Written by the Architect 2026-11-12 for the Owner; the Owner ratifies, the Architect does not ratify what it authored. The must-ask values (specialist, bounds, standard_ref) ARE carried at top level, as every staged packet in this programme carries them, so the Owner can read every term in one place. That shape fails the corpus gate for a reason that is structural and is not this packet's defect: see schema_contradiction.
proposed.threshold_mapping: Binary scale per dimension: 1 = the case passes, 0 = it does not. pass = mean >= T_accept(1) AND min >= T_dim(1), i.e. every one of the 14 collected cases passes. Any 0 with iterations < cap -> regenerate; at cap -> needs_owner. T_reject 0 means the algebra never rejects (min < 0 impossible); rejected stays the Owner's call.
